extracted.name: Poppyseed Salad Dressing
extracted.description: Poppyseed Dressing is so much more than just a creamy dressing with poppyseed in it. The poppyseeds ada a beautiful nutty aroma, and can take an otherwise humble salad to new heights!
ingredient_lines: 1 eschalot / French shallot (("shallot" in the US i.e. the small onions), finely chopped)
1/2 tsp mustard powder ((or 1 tsp mild English mustard, not hot))
1 tbsp mayonnaise ((can omit, makes it creamier))
1/2 cup olive oil or grapeseed oil
instruction_lines: Place ingredients in a jar. Shake very well. Adjust salt and pepper to taste. Store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
